title: Regularity and singularity of the blow-up curve for a wave equation with a derivative nonlinearity and a scale-invariant damping
summary: In this article, we investigate the blow-up behavior of solutions to the one-dimensional damped nonlinear wave equation, namely $$ \partial_t^2 u - \partial_x^2 u + \fracμ{1 + t} \partial_t u = |\partial_t u|^p \quad (p > 1). $$ Under the assumption of sufficiently large and smooth initial data, we establish that the blow-up curve is continuously differentiable ($\mathcal{C}^1$). A key step in our analysis involves the characterization of the blow-up profile of the solution.
